sections.subtitle: Tense changes
items: Present Perfect Continuous -> Past Perfect Continuous
Past Simple -> Past Perfect Simple / Past Simple
Past Perfect Continuous -> Past Perfect Continuous (No cambia)
sections.example: Alvaro said: 'I have been working hard' -> Alvaro said (that) he had been working hard.

sections.subtitle: Modals
items: No cambian: should, ought to, could, might, would, had better
sections.example: She said: 'I can swim' -> She said she could swim.

sections.subtitle: Time/Place Expressions
items: tomorrow -> the next day / the following day
yesterday -> the day before / the previous day
last year -> the year before / the previous year
sections.example: He said: 'I will do it tomorrow here' -> He said he would do it the following day there.

sections.subtitle: Questions & Commands
items: El orden de las palabras pasa a ser Afirmativo (Sujeto + Verbo), sin auxiliares (do/does/did).
Commands: verbo introductorio (tell, order) + object + to-infinitive / not to-infinitive.
sections.example: He asked: 'Did you see him?' -> He asked me if I had seen him.

sections.subtitle: Verbs + Object + To-Inf
sections.example: The teacher urged the students to study harder.

templates.structure: It is widely believed that [clause], but I would argue that...
templates.example: It is widely believed that technology isolates us, but I would argue that it connects us more.
templates.translation: Se cree ampliamente que [cláusula], pero yo argumentaría que...

templates.structure: As my partner rightly pointed out, we shouldn't forget that...
templates.example: As my partner rightly pointed out, we shouldn't forget that pollution is a major issue.
templates.translation: Como bien señaló mi compañero/a, no debemos olvidar que...

templates.structure: Experts have repeatedly warned us not to [verb]...
templates.example: Experts have repeatedly warned us not to rely solely on fossil fuels.
templates.translation: Los expertos nos han advertido repetidamente que no [verbo]...

templates.structure: The person in the first picture seems to be suggesting that...
templates.example: The person in the first picture seems to be suggesting that teamwork is essential.
templates.translation: La persona de la primera foto parece estar sugiriendo que...
